scheme_name: "Fishing Ban Period Assistance" under "Welfare and Relief for Fishermen During Lean Seasons and Natural Calamities Scheme"
description:
The "Fishing Ban Period Assistance" is a significant welfare initiative under the broader "Welfare and Relief for Fishermen During Lean Seasons and Natural Calamities Scheme" launched by the Government of India.

This scheme was officially launched on June 24, 2021.

The primary objective of this assistance program is to provide financial support to fishermen during the fishing ban period.

The fishing ban period typically occurs to allow fish breeding and ensure sustainable fishing practices.

The ban period varies by region but generally lasts for about 45 to 60 days.

During this time, fishermen are unable to engage in their primary source of income.

The scheme aims to mitigate the economic impact of this ban on the livelihoods of fishermen.

The assistance provided under this scheme is intended to support families during this lean season.

Eligible fishermen receive a financial assistance amount of ₹4,000.

This amount is provided directly to the bank accounts of the beneficiaries.

The scheme is designed to benefit approximately 1.5 million fishermen across the country.

Eligibility for the Fishing Ban Period Assistance is primarily based on the following criteria.

Applicants must be registered fishermen with valid identification.

They should possess a fishing license issued by the respective state government.

The age limit for eligibility is set at a minimum of 18 years.

There is no upper age limit specified for this scheme.

Income criteria are also taken into consideration.

Fishermen whose annual income does not exceed ₹3 lakh are eligible.

This income limit is aimed at targeting the economically weaker sections of the fishing community.

The application process for the Fishing Ban Period Assistance is straightforward.

Interested fishermen must apply through the respective state fisheries department.

The application can be submitted online or in person at designated offices.

Required documents include a valid fishing license, identity proof, and bank account details.

Fishermen must also provide a self-declaration of their annual income.

Once the application is submitted, it is verified by the fisheries department officials.

The verification process typically takes about 15 to 30 days.

Upon successful verification, the financial assistance is disbursed.

The disbursement is made directly to the bank accounts of the beneficiaries.

This ensures transparency and reduces the chances of corruption.

The assistance is provided once during each fishing ban period.

The frequency of the ban period varies by state.

In many coastal states, the ban period is observed from June to July.

This is aligned with the monsoon season when fish breeding occurs.

The implementation of this scheme is overseen by the Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying.

Each state has its own fisheries department responsible for execution.

Contact details for the respective state fisheries departments can be found on their official websites.

The scheme has been well-received by the fishing community.

It has been instrumental in providing a safety net during the lean seasons.

Feedback from beneficiaries indicates that the assistance has helped them meet basic needs.

The government has allocated a budget of ₹600 crore for this scheme in the financial year 2021-2022.

This allocation is aimed at ensuring that the assistance reaches all eligible fishermen.

The scheme is part of the government's larger initiative to promote sustainable fishing practices.

It also aims to enhance the socio-economic conditions of fishermen.

The Fishing Ban Period Assistance is a crucial component of the government's efforts to support the fishing community.

It reflects the government's commitment to welfare and relief for vulnerable sections of society.

The scheme is expected to be reviewed periodically to assess its effectiveness.

The government plans to expand the reach of the scheme in the coming years.

This includes increasing the financial assistance amount based on inflation and rising costs.

The Fishing Ban Period Assistance is a vital lifeline for many families dependent on fishing.

It helps to ensure food security and economic stability during challenging times.

The scheme also emphasizes the importance of sustainable fishing practices.

By enforcing fishing bans, the government aims to replenish fish stocks.

This is crucial for the long-term viability of the fishing industry.

The Fishing Ban Period Assistance is one of several initiatives aimed at supporting fishermen.

Other related schemes include the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana.

This scheme focuses on enhancing fish production and productivity.

The government is committed to improving the overall welfare of the fishing community.

The Fishing Ban Period Assistance is a testament to this commitment.

It highlights the importance of providing targeted support to those in need.

The scheme is expected to evolve based on feedback from the fishing community.

This will ensure that it remains relevant and effective in addressing their needs.

The Fishing Ban Period Assistance is a critical step towards ensuring the sustainability of the fishing sector.

It also plays a role in the broader context of rural development and poverty alleviation.

The government is keen on promoting responsible fishing practices.

This is essential for maintaining ecological balance in marine environments.

The Fishing Ban Period Assistance is a key element in achieving these goals.

It reflects a holistic approach to fisheries management and community welfare.

The scheme is a significant move towards empowering fishermen and their families.

It acknowledges the challenges faced by the fishing community during lean seasons.

The Fishing Ban Period Assistance is a model for similar welfare initiatives in other sectors.

It showcases the importance of timely and effective government intervention.

The scheme is a crucial part of India's commitment to sustainable development.

It aligns with global goals for responsible resource management.

The Fishing Ban Period Assistance is an essential support mechanism for the fishing community.

It is designed to ensure that fishermen can weather the challenges posed by seasonal bans.

This assistance is vital for maintaining their livelihoods and supporting their families.

The scheme is a clear indication of the government's dedication to the welfare of fishermen.

It aims to provide them with the necessary support during difficult times.
